snippet.title: SPACE WHIP 0.0.4
snippet.description:
!!! THIS IS NOT A FINISHED PRODUCT !!!

Space Whip is an immersive movement shooter in a megastructure with a grapling-hook
We will improve it in the future, the game lacks in a lot of aspects, but check it out anyway
